## Accepted partial result, attempt 1/5

Problem 10300012 / AMR-102-0012, rank 1247, Calegari Question 6.2. The base-manifold isotopy and insulator questions remain unresolved; no novelty or current-openness certification is claimed.

The complete authored proof and audit establish unknotted universal lifts for the ordinary prescribed ideal-polygon disk-bundle core in the closed orientable hyperbolic setting; a homeomorphic lift in a finite cover isotopic to a simple geodesic with arbitrarily large embedded tube and the stated insulator conclusion; and the explicitly conditional base length/tube criterion. The completion-map and entire strip-isotopy repairs, winding-one Core Lemma argument, all strict inequalities, and authored helical comparison are retained in full. Actual cyclic subgroup separability covers proper powers. No base primitivity, regular-cover degree preservation, isotopy descent or full-group insulator extension is inferred.

Gabai–Kazez is imported through Calegari's explicit attributed product statement. The original PDF returned HTTP 403 and the original proof was not audited. The recent Anosov preprint is a literature caution only, neither a dependency nor a lamination counterexample. The remaining base-manifold obligations stay explicit.

## Exact publication boundary and review limits

Only six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10300012/`. Programs, supplemental computation descriptions/results, certificates, fixtures, imported dataset contents, copied scholarly source bodies/images, private original/version identities and private coordination material are excluded. No excluded computation is rewritten as prose.

This edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Recorded source retrieval, exact matches and inspection remain historical observations; editorial preparation makes no fresh scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature-search claim.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
